What it owns: Chain definition, step resolution, SLA, escalation, delegation, versioning, HR override
Consumed by: Leave, gate pass, overtime, regularisation, loan sanction, guarantor acceptance, requisition, letters, recognition, clearance, assignment change, payroll approval, agent approval
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT write a per-module approval table. Thirteen consumers, one engine.

What it owns: Append-only transaction rows with credit, debit, reversal, lapse and an idempotency key; balance as a projection
Consumed by: Leave balance, comp-off, loan outstanding, gate-pass minutes used, EWA accrual, late-instance counting
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT add a running-balance column anywhere. v1.0 did and v1.1 removed it.

What it owns: Topological node evaluation, versioned rule packs, intermediate value capture, explainability trace
Consumed by: Payroll gross-to-net, wage-base simulation, F&F, arrears, off-cycle OT, gratuity and bonus provisioning, encashment
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT hand-code a formula in a module. Every computation is a node.

What it owns: Merge fields, version pinning, draft-then-human-review, issue register, file retention
Consumed by: Letters, statutory forms, announcements, payslip PDF, offer letters, certificates, filing packs
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT build a second renderer for statutory forms. Same engine, different templates.

What it owns: Idempotent projection over immutable events with as-at policy reads, delta output, isolated execution
Consumed by: Attendance day, disposition, overtime, gate-pass credit, leave-linked days, contractor attendance, analytics projections
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT recompute inline in the request path, and do NOT edit derived rows by hand.

What it owns: A gate that holds an operation while named prerequisites are open, with explicit waiver and reason
Consumed by: Payroll input lock, clearance blocking F&F, GL mapping blocking approval, CRITICAL audit flag blocking approval, guarantor lock blocking eligibility
Anti-pattern to avoid: Five features, one mechanism. Implement the lock once and configure the prerequisites.

What it owns: Append-only record of actor, agent, before, after, reason, IP; sensitive-read logging; reversal handles
Consumed by: Every write in the product, every sensitive read, every agent action, every override and waiver
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT scatter module-specific history tables.

What it owns: Transactional outbox, relay worker, idempotent consumers, CloudEvents envelope
Consumed by: Recompute triggers, notifications, analytics projections, webhooks, integration dispatch, learning assignment, announcements
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT call another module synchronously for a side effect.

What it owns: Tenant ∩ entity ∩ location ∩ reporting line ∩ payroll group, evaluated at query time, with field-level nulling
Consumed by: Every list, every report, every export, every API read, every tool call, team history, payslip visibility
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT filter in the UI. The plant-user test (RL-005) runs on every build.

What it owns: Versioned, effective-dated, jurisdiction-scoped declarative packs with their own test suites and changelog
Consumed by: PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity, bonus, overtime multipliers, leave statutory minima, form applicability
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT branch on state inside application code. Ever.

What it owns: Config objects with validity, the as-at reader, and the override-with-reason pattern
Consumed by: Worker class, designation, shift, rule sets, leave policy, calendars, GL mapping, ownership map, sanctioned strength, approval chains
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT read today's configuration when computing a past date.

What it owns: Provider-neutral LLM calls, prompt versioning, cost attribution, caching, plus the agent policy gate and tool registry
Consumed by: Policy assistant, document extraction, duplicate detection, review drafting, candidate matching, anomaly detection, every agent
Anti-pattern to avoid: Do NOT call a vendor SDK from domain code, and do NOT give an agent a non-tool path to data.
